semantics.callbacks: sample-weighted global raw rewards from newly generated episodes; replay excluded
semantics.training_log: global learner population including replay, supplied as scalar metrics even when the main worker has no generated episodes
semantics.groups: average size uses nonempty groups; diversity mean/std weights groups with at least two observed rewards
semantics.median: exact float64 order selection by cumulative counts; canonical signed zero; correctly rounded even midpoint using two exact ratios
semantics.wire: own DDP process group, controls with protocol agreement, 4 int64 counts and 8 float64 summaries; median uses at most 64 reductions of two int64 counts
semantics.resources: O(local population) CPU storage, no gathering reward vectors, trajectories or text
semantics.failures: coherent local admission/schema rejection preserves learner state and supports corrected inputs
semantics.logger_api: optional keyword trajectory_metrics takes precedence over local groups; inspectable legacy logger gets global scalars without raw groups; bodies are called once
semantics.callback_isolation: top-level metrics and nested population summaries copied before callback dispatch
semantics.protocol: native loop v2 admission rejects mismatched loop generations before episodes

boundaries: Generated tiny FP32 CPU/Gloo learners and synthetic rewards. Diagnostic history and task/final flush reporting remain open. All live peers must enter the same operation; external callback/environment state, incompatible callback collectives and process loss are outside the protocol.
count_note: Targeted source/wheel tests overlap. Ten actual two-worker pytest contracts contain multiple scenarios; the 21 new scenarios per peer are not separate pytest cases.
